own_via_window_formula: actual via radius + 0.127mm clearance + 2*0.005mm native-design polygon allowance
limits: This records exact saved-plane centerline and finite-width projection. Empty outside-window projection is a geometric check only.
Own-via windows are reported explicitly, not claimed to be solid reference copper.
No transient return-current extraction, crosstalk, EMI, manufacturing-tolerance or flight qualification is claimed.
